summary: T16 fully implements the saved plan. AC1: scripts/check_release_artifacts.py re-derives the manifest via generate_install_manifest.build_manifest (pinning generated_at), asserts field-level equality, independently validates checksum coverage, and is wired as the 'Verify release artifact drift' step in the publish.yml build job. AC2: scripts/release_smoke.py provides build_smoke_manifest (file:// URL rewrite preserving sha256/name/kind), smoke_invocation (dry-run argv + AWF_INSTALL_MANIFEST env with channel derived from manifest), and main(--run); a new installer-smoke job (needs: build) downloads python-distributions + python-distribution-checksums, checks out the repo, and runs the smoke with --run. AC3: RELEASING.md adds a 'Verify release artifacts (drift + installer smoke)' subsection. AC4: the publish job is unchanged, keeping its workflow_dispatch + inputs.publish_target != 'none' Trusted Publishing gate. AC5: new tests in tests/unit/scripts/test_check_release_artifacts.py and test_release_smoke.py cover fixtures, tampered sha256, missing/extra artifacts, edited checksum digest, channel/version/tag mismatch, smoke command generation (uv/pipx), prerelease channel, and checksum-mismatch-before-install; workflow/docs static tests are extended. Plan and validation docs exist; non-goals honored (no ci.yml change, only RELEASING.md touched, smoke in publish.yml). Validation doc records focused pytest (707 / 41 passed), ruff, and --help evidence; working tree is clean and committed.
